item.description: Glasgow Warriors hooker Aicha Sutcliffe will make her first Scotland start in one of three changes made by interim head coach Dave Butcher for their final WXV Global Series match against Australia in Canberra on Friday. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Live: RBA deputy acknowledges rate rises 'laying pain on top of pain'
item.description: Data centre operator NextDC's shares have tanked after returning to trade following a suspension. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Ellis scores monster 47 points, most in WNBL game for over two decades
item.description: Townsville's Abbey Ellis has produced one of the all-time great WNBL individual performances with a mammoth 47-point effort in the Fire's 86-68 away win over Adelaide. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Nightlife venues embrace 'experience economy' as alcohol consumption falls
item.description: With gen Z drinking less, nightlife venues are pivoting their businesses to become meeting places to socialise or host micro events to stay afloat. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Gardner smashes 84 as Australia retains Rose Bowl over NZ
item.description: Australia retains the Rose Bowl with a comfortable 40-run victory in the Twenty20 International against New Zealand at North Sydney Oval. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: For Australia’s Indigenous Desert Alliance, caring for Country starts with a story
item.description: This week on the Mongabay Newscast, Samantha Murray, CEO of the Indigenous Desert Alliance, joins the program to discuss the IDA’s recent nomination for an Earthshot Prize. The alliance is a network of 70 ranger teams across the Australian desert, covering 270 million hectares (667 million acres), an area almost as large as Argentina. This […] Fuente: Mongabay.

item.title: Bavuma's batting masterclass takes control from Australia
item.description: He may be small in stature, but Temba Bavuma has once again stood tall for his country and taken control away from Australia. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: A government-funded study into e-mobility use in Queensland has found there are close to 1 million privately owned devices. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Embattled AI data centre company Firmus says one of its planned projects in Tasmania's north is not yet funded, and it is still seeking development approval at another site. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Golden North's ice cream factory starts production at new site
item.description: After leaving its home of more than a century, South Australian ice cream producer Golden North has started production at its new home 270 kilometres away. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Marco Jansen's swashbuckling innings ends with a bang then a whimper as Temba Bavuma plays one of the great captain's knocks. Here are the quick hits from day three of the second Test between Australia and South Africa. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Adelaide restaurateurs say Michelin guide recognition 'a great honour'
item.description: The Ayubi family decided to share their culture through food after fleeing to Australia in the Cold War. They have now been recognised by the world's most prestigious restaurant guide. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Loan of $20m to troubled smelter deemed high risk, govt went ahead anyway
item.description: The Tasmanian government was advised to approve a $20 million loan to the country's only manganese smelter last year despite knowing the risk of not getting all the money back was high, as inaction was deemed too risky. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: What's behind the pile-on for 'Oscar contender' and stinging satire, Digger?
item.description: Despite its obvious craftsmanship as one of the most original films of the decade, Digger was panned by early critics. Is it a case of tall poppy syndrome, or is something else at play? Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Which island is home to the quokka? And which capital city would you find on the banks of the Vltava River? Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Seven West Media had 'diabolical' culture, secret review hears
item.description: A bombshell review of Seven West Media in 2024 has been told of a "diabolical" corporate culture, with allegations sexism, bullying and harassment were rife and "sacred cow" executives favoured by then-chairman Kerry Stokes were protected amid a ratings obsession. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
